detail: Full summary: git broke mid-session at 13:33 — /Applications/Xcode.app was updated (mtime 13:33, root) so Apple's /usr/bin/git now exits with 'You have not agreed to the Xcode license agreements'; /opt/homebrew/bin/git does not exist; brew itself fails the same way. Workaround in use: prefix PATH with /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin (git 2.50.1 works). Permanent fix is Dave's: `sudo xcodebuild -license accept`. Until then every git-spawning test, hook and subagent that uses the plain PATH fails; the first Stage 0 commit attempt was silently lost this way (exit printed empty hash) and was redone as 474dfac.
